jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Developer Enablement
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Hinge Health is pioneering the world's most patient-centered Digital Musculoskeletal (MSK) Clinic. We are building a world-class R&D organization where engineers, product managers and designers can move fast with confidence, create high-quality solutions and stay deeply engaged in their work.





ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead Agentic Engineering and Developer Experience across Hinge Health R&D. In this role, you will treat the software development lifecycle as a product—using agentic workflows, developer platforms, and automation to transform how we build, test, deploy, and operate software.

You will own the product strategy and roadmap for improving the end-to-end developer experience, identifying and eliminating friction from concept and code creation through testing, deployment, and observability. Your goal will be to help our teams deliver high-quality products faster, more reliably, and with greater confidence. Working closely with engineering and technical leaders, you will uncover where development slows down, identify the highest-leverage opportunities for improvement, and translate them into products, platforms, and workflows that drive measurable gains in developer velocity, software quality, and developer satisfaction.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

You will define and drive Hinge Health’s strategy for Agentic Engineering and Developer Experience, partnering with technical leaders across Service Enablement, App Enablement, Platform Quality, SRE, Security, and Infrastructure to identify where AI agents, automation, developer platforms, and workflow improvements can meaningfully increase R&D capacity. You will own developer efficiency as a product area, translating real-world engineering friction into prioritized quarterly roadmaps and measurable investments that improve how teams build, ship and operate software.

 - Advance Agentic Development: Identify, validate, and scale AI-powered workflows across coding, testing, debugging, observability, and knowledge discovery. Measure success through demonstrated improvements in productivity, quality, and developer experience—not tool adoption alone.

 - Accelerate Developer Velocity: Improve local development, CI/CD, build and test infrastructure, code review, ephemeral environments, and release workflows to shorten feedback loops and reduce lead time for changes.

 - Build Paved Roads: Partner with engineering teams to create reusable platforms, self-service capabilities, and standardized development paths that reduce unnecessary complexity and make it easier to build and ship software.

 - Measure Engineering Effectiveness: Establish and track a clear measurement framework spanning DXI, DORA metrics, PR throughput and cycle time, deployment frequency, lead time for changes, build and test performance, MTTR, and developer satisfaction.

 - Represent the Developer Voice: Use listening tours, workflow analysis, engineering data, and developer feedback to identify friction and translate it into prioritized product opportunities.

 - Drive Cross-Functional Adoption: Partner across App Enablement, Security, Infrastructure, and SRE to improve development and release workflows while balancing velocity with reliability, compliance, security, and platform scalability. Drive adoption of new developer platforms, agentic capabilities, and engineering practices across a large, distributed R&D organization.





QUALIFICATIONS

We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can partner with engineers and translate complex engineering challenges into product strategy.

 - 5+ years of Product Management experience, including experience with developer experience, engineering productivity, developer platforms, infrastructure, or other deeply technical products.

 - Strong understanding of modern software development, including CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, testing, observability, and release processes.

 - Experience using engineering productivity or developer experience metrics to identify opportunities and measure impact.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional technical initiatives and drive adoption of new tools, platforms, or engineering practices.
   
   
   


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Previous hands-on software engineering or other technical experience.

 - Experience with agentic development workflows or AI tools that measurably improve developer productivity.

Experience building or scaling internal developer platforms, platform engineering capabilities, or complex application development environments.


Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com http://hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

At Hinge Health, we’re transforming care at scale, helping millions of people live pain-free lives. Now, we're looking for a Director of Product Management to lead one of our most member-critical product areas: the Member Journey.

Member Journey defines the framework for the end-to-end experience. That includes how members enroll, receive care, and see a reduction in their pain through Hinge Health. This is the leader for a group of product pods directly tied to our core member outcomes: onboarding, long term retention, new program growth, and outcomes. Done well, it turns an employer benefit into a habit-forming care relationship.

As a Director of Product Management, you'll lead a team of PMs to define the vision for the next-generation member experience in digital healthcare, including how personalization and AI reshape what it means to deliver care at scale.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

 - Set the Strategic Vision: Define and communicate a multi-year product vision and strategy for the Member Journey neighborhood, ensuring alignment with Hinge Health's broader goals.

 - Lead and Grow the Team: Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers. Foster a culture of ownership, member obsession, and operational excellence.

 - Drive Enrollment, Retention, and Outcomes: Transform the member lifecycle from triage through long-term retention and ultimately driving long term change for members. Identify friction points, develop program platforms, growing our suite of programs and program extensions, and developing habits that keep members coming back.

 - Scale for New Care Programs: Build a member experience that extends gracefully to new conditions and care models without creating fragmentation or inconsistency across the product.

 - AI & Personalization Innovation: Define and execute how AI and personalization make the member experience more adaptive, relevant, and effective.

 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner deeply with Clinical, Design, and Data Science to understand member needs and translate them into a cohesive product roadmap. Work with Engineering and Design to ensure high-quality, scalable execution.


 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

 - 10+  years in Product Management building consumer-facing products or B2B2C platforms

 - 4+ years managing a team of Product Managers/Senior Product Managers

 - Experience managing foundational platforms at scale, not just owning features.

 - Comfortable working with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders (Pacific Time)

 - Technical fluency, specifically ability to engage deeply on data models, experimentation infrastructure, and system design

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills to work effectively in async, globally distributed teams, paired with strong project management and a bias for urgency to drive execution.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience in Digital Health or consumer health products.

 - Experience managing platform teams and driving significant architectural designs.

 - Familiarity with AI/ML applications in personalization, recommendations, or behavior change.

 - Strong background in experimentation and A/B testing at scale.

 - Experience with consumer lifecycle management, activation funnels, or engagement mechanics.


ABOUT HINGE HEALTH

Hinge Health is moving people beyond pain by transforming how it’s treated and prevented. Combining advanced technology, AI, and a dedicated care team of experts, we guide people through personalized MSK care directly from their phones. Our platform addresses the full spectrum of musculoskeletal needs—from acute injury and chronic pain to post-surgical rehabilitation—helping members reduce pain, improve function, and avoid unnecessary surgeries.

Our approach is proven to reduce pain by 68%, prevent 42% of new opioid prescriptions, and avoid more than half of joint replacement surgeries. Trusted by leading employers and health plans—including Land O’Lakes, L.L. Bean, Salesforce, US Foods, and Verizon—Hinge Health serves more than 18 million people. Learn more at www.hingehealth.com http://www.hingehealth.com




WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT US

 - Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).

 - Grow with us - buy discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.

 - Modern life stipends: We also offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally..

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Products
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Hinge Health is looking for an experienced, mission-driven Senior Product Manager to join our consumer product team. In this role, you will lead the strategic vision and execution of a high-impact consumer product surface, focusing on creating deeply personalized and engaging experiences for our members.

As a Senior PM, you will be a leader within the product organization, working closely with cross-functional partners in engineering, design, and clinical teams to deliver innovative solutions at scale. This role requires a "product crafter" mindset—someone who can balance experimentation with long-term strategic thinking.

What makes you a great fit

 1. Product Intuition: You notice subtle things about products and people, anticipating non-obvious user problems and identifying opportunities for delight.

 2. Strategic Ownership: You operate with a CEO-like sense of ownership, taking complete accountability for your product area's performance and outcomes.

 3. Ambiguity Navigator: You thrive in entrepreneurial environments, developing high-quality hypotheses and moving work forward even when success is not yet well-defined.

 4. Collaborative Leader: You serve as an advocate for your engineering and design counterparts, providing clear direction and context to drive productive collaboration.

 5. Metrics & Experimentation: You have a strong aptitude for A/B experimentation and a track record of optimizing key product metrics, using data to drive informed decisions and measurable outcomes.

What You'll Accomplish

 - Define Product Vision: Take a major role in defining the product vision, strategy, and objectives for your product area.

 - Drive Engagement: Own the roadmap for consumer-facing features that drive user engagement, retention, and clinical outcomes.

 - Ship at Scale: Ship high-quality features within a cross-functional pod, working directly with executives as the voice of your team.

 - Metric Accountability: Establish success metrics and use both quantitative and qualitative data to adjust strategy mid-flight.

Basic Qualifications

 - Experience: 5-7+ years of product management experience, specifically in consumer-facing features and personalized user experiences.

 - Data Rigor: Demonstrated ability to make data-driven decisions and optimize lifecycle metrics (engagement, retention); experience in single hypothesis-driven testing and experimental design.

 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Healthcare experience: Experience in digital product development within the healthcare, fitness, or mind-body therapy space




HINGE HEALTH HYBRID MODEL

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days per week, for the full 8 hours of a typical business day. The San Francisco office is a dog-friendly workplace.

At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1.7 billion people worldwide. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence-based care.

As the preferred partner to 50+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, New Verticals
jobs.description:
PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER, NEW VERTICALS




THE OPPORTUNITY

Help expand Hinge Health access by turning complex products into clear stories, successful launches, and meaningful client adoption. As Product Marketing Manager, New Verticals, you will lead product marketing for new expansions. You will partner closely with Health Services to support health-plan approvals and with Client Success to help clients understand and adopt new offerings.



Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, Digital Care, you will own GTM strategy and execution, from positioning and launch planning to building slides, writing messaging, and leading live enablement. Your work will help establish Hinge Health as a market leader in new verticals.




WHAT YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH

In your first three months:

 - Build expertise in current new verticals solutions, including its strengths, differentiators, and messaging within your first 30 days.

 - Create and improve slides, messaging, FAQs, and objection-handling resources that support health-plan approvals and client conversations.

 - Lead enablement sessions within your first 60 days and develop a reliable approach to answering questions and maintaining useful resources.



In your first six months:

 - Independently own the product marketing work supporting New verticals expansion, prioritizing approval needs with Health Services and delivering the assets partners need to move decisions forward.

 - Drive client readiness and adoption for new offerings through coordinated launch communications, practical resources, and live enablement.

 - Establish adoption measures with Client Success and use client feedback, recurring objections, and performance data to improve messaging and launch execution.



In your first year:

 - Help expand new verticals availability across the book of business by supporting outstanding health-plan approvals.

 - Drive measurable client adoption of new offerings against agreed goals, tracking adoption separately from health-plan approval coverage.

 - Lead go-to-market planning and execution for the product expansions, aligning positioning, audiences, launch milestones, partner readiness, and measurement with the product roadmap.

 - Keep cross-functional partners and leadership informed with concise updates on progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.


WHO YOU ARE

 - A clear communicator: You translate complex clinical and product information into concise messaging, well-structured slides, and effective live presentations. You can recommend a course of action and answer senior stakeholders’ questions directly.

 - A hands-on owner: You connect business priorities to daily execution, create the assets yourself, and take accountability for commitments and results.

 - A Learn-it-All: You seek feedback, apply it without defensiveness, and quickly build fluency in unfamiliar products and markets.

 - A trusted partner: You work efficiently with Health Services, Client Success, Product, and Clinical partners, make tradeoffs explicit, and follow through.

 - A resourceful problem-solver: You bring urgency and sound judgment, adapt when priorities change, and keep work moving through constraints.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience independently owning product positioning, go-to-market launches, or product-adoption initiatives with measurable outcomes.

 - Demonstrated ability to create clear messaging and presentation materials and deliver live enablement for business or client-facing teams.

 - Experience leading cross-functional work from planning through execution, influencing partners without direct authority, and improving work through feedback.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Product marketing experience in healthcare, digital health, or another complex, evidence-based category.

 - Experience working with benefit managers, health plans, or healthcare services teams.

 - Experience enabling sales, client success, or partnership teams to drive adoption.

 - Experience translating clinical or technical information into differentiated, business-relevant positioning.

 - Experience measuring adoption and using customer feedback to improve go-to-market execution.
